home.title: MCM Luxury Custom Palermo | Tuning, Wrapping & Supercars
home.description: Mavira Charter Motorsport, Palermo (Sicily): supercar customisation, wrapping and PPF, Tubi Style exhausts, tuning, luxury car sales and rental.

hero.lead: Customisation, tuning and wrapping for sports and luxury cars. Every project is built in our workshop, piece by piece, with the obsessive care your car deserves.

items.d: Body kits, aero, wheels and styling details designed around each car. From the Porsche 996 to the Ferrari F430, complete transformations.
Gloss, matte, satin or titanium car wraps and paint protection film, including carbon PPF. A reversible new look with protected paintwork.
We are an authorised Tubi Style dealer: racing exhaust systems for Porsche, Ferrari, Maserati, Lamborghini and more.
Stage 1 and power upgrades verified on the dyno. Measured performance, not promises.
Selected sports and luxury cars, some already customised in our workshop. Ask us what is available now.
Rent a supercar for an event, a wedding, a photo shoot or simply for the pleasure of driving it.

works.lead: A few projects that left Officine MCM. More every week on Instagram.

about.p1: MCM stands for Mavira Charter Motorsport: a workshop in Palermo born from a passion for sports cars and luxury tuning. Here every car is treated as a one-off.
about.p2: We work on supercars, SUVs and sports cars of every make: from styling to mechanics, from choosing materials to final delivery. We attend the main car meets and motorsport events and work with brands such as Tubi Style.

contact.lead: Tell us about your project and we will reply with a tailored proposal.
